What Seeds is

A non-custodial crypto exchange. People keep control of
their own keys and assets, and with that, responsibility for
them.

Who it serves

Experienced crypto users who expect precision, and people
who are still learning how self-custody works.

A seed holds potential. With the right conditions and
care, it becomes something of value. Seeds gives people
clear tools to take part in crypto on their own terms, with
ownership and responsibility made plain.
